notes: One class of registered shares, priced on its primary listing on the SIX Swiss Exchange (NOVN.SW, CHF), not the NYSE ADRs (NVS; one ADR represents one share). The count excludes treasury shares and is from the latest interim report (September 30, 2026); the 20-F's December 31, 2025 count of 1,908,151,679 is older, and the interim report says shares outstanding fell by 19.6 million in the first nine months of 2026 through buybacks.
